_comment: M9.1 (docs/plans/GLOBAL-PLAN.md) — Discord AutoMod rules for the Game On Portugal guild,
STARTER FILE — the one rule below is disabled and its keyword is a placeholder, not a real
blocklist. Nobody has been asked what this Portuguese community actually wants blocked, and
that call belongs to Luis, not to whoever wrote the mechanism. Before this is ever applied for
real: 1) decide the actual keyword/regex blocklist (pt-PT slurs/spam/scam patterns are the
obvious candidates, per the old bot's `regex` validator), 2) decide which role(s), if any, go
in exemptRoles so moderators are never blocked by their own rules, 3) decide which channels (if
any) belong in commandsOnlyChannels below — the old `specialchannels` table was empty in
production, so there is nothing to port forward, only a fresh decision to make, 4) flip
`enabled` to true on the rules you actually want live. Until then this file only documents the
mechanism; running `--apply` with it as-is creates one disabled, harmless placeholder rule and
touches no channel permissions at all.
